card.name: Homework and Q&A forum phrasing
card.fires_on: The word homework and the words just around it in a forum post, such as "not helping me do my homework". It also fires weakly on scattered words in online question-and-answer pages.

modes.label: Homework disclaimer
modes.description: Words in a poster's note that the question is not homework, strongest on homework itself.
modes.example: Important note: You are not helping me do my<< homework>>. This is for a competition for engineering

modes.label: Q&A site chrome
modes.description: Scattered words in answer-site page text, such as rating answers or asking questions.
modes.example: View and<< rate>> new answers There are no new answers

card.plain: It lights up on homework-help wording in online question-and-answer posts.
